summary.one_liner: A curated "awesome" list of Python asyncio frameworks, libraries, tools, writings, talks, and alternatives to asyncio.
summary.what_it_does: This is a link list, not a code project. It is organized into sections: Web Frameworks, Message Queues, Database Drivers, Networking, GraphQL, Testing, Alternative Loops, Misc, Writings, Talks, and Alternatives to asyncio. Each entry is a one-line description of a library or resource, such as aiohttp for HTTP client/server, aiokafka for Kafka, asyncpg for PostgreSQL, and pytest-asyncio for testing. The Writings section covers docs, tutorials, and articles, and the Talks section lists recorded conference talks. The README notes the maintainer is no longer maintaining the list and is looking for someone to take it over.
use_cases: learn asyncio from articles and talks
find asyncio testing and mocking tools
compare asyncio alternatives like trio and curio
notable: Covers web frameworks, database drivers, message queues, and testing tools for asyncio in one list
Includes a Writings section with tutorials and the official asyncio docs
Includes a Talks section with recorded conference talks about asyncio
Has an Alternatives section covering trio, curio, and AnyIO
caveats: The maintainer no longer maintains the list and is seeking a new maintainer
Entries are one-line descriptions only; the list does not show library activity or current status
